summary.ru: Югославия — государство в Южной Европе на Балканском полуострове, созданное в 1918 году и просуществовавшее вплоть до 2003 года, когда оно было преобразовано в Сербию и Черногорию.
summary.en: Yugoslavia was a country in Central Europe and the Balkans that existed from 1918 to 1992. It came into existence following World War I, under the name of the Kingdom of Serbs, Croats and Slovenes, from the merger of the Kingdom of Serbia with the provisional State of Slovenes, Croats and Serbs, and constituted the first union of South Slavic peoples as a sovereign state, following centuries of foreign rule over the region under the Ottoman Empire and the Habsburg monarchy.
